verdict.rationale: Smart Capture Link is a first-party, Entrust-hosted verification journey that is sent to customers and is documented as letting you verify individuals with or without engineering effort. It runs on top of the no-code Workflow Studio builder, so an ops lead can send a verification without filing an engineering ticket. missing for 10: explicit QR-code delivery, documentation of how an ops user generates and sends a one-off link from the Dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller

citations.quote: Smart Capture Link is a low- to no-code frontend solution complementing Workflow Studio, allowing you to verify individuals with or without engineering effort.
The Smart Capture Link is then sent to your customers, redirecting them towards the interactive steps of a workflow.
It's a no-code, drag and drop interface that allows you to build, maintain and update workflows seamlessly without the need for developer involvement.
